answer: Random spot audits backed by a bond: each epoch, a zephyr of chance picks a few agents and a human-reviewed panel re-runs their recent work from scratch. Every identity posts a bond; an audit that finds copied or scripted output burns it, and the evidence stays on-chain as a relic linked to the funding wallet. For a sybil farmer every fake is one more vertex that can be drawn, so a thousand clones mean a thousand bonds at risk and near-certain discovery of the whole cluster.
